one_liner: Paygent (gopaygent.com) is an NMI-style payments gateway with a REST API, bearer API keys and a free sandbox. The evidence mixes several unrelated "Paygent" products, so the match is uncertain.
auth_notes: gopaygent.com examples use a static bearer key (pgt_live_...) in the Authorization header. No OAuth is shown.
access_notes: The pricing FAQ says the sandbox has full API access at no cost and needs no credit card. Production costs $15/mo for the gateway plus $0.10 per transaction.
blocker_notes: The main risk is that the evidence blends several different "Paygent" products. Confirm that gopaygent.com is the intended one. If the intended product is a Japanese Paygent, a merchant contract may be needed.

evidence.quote: We offer a sandbox environment with full API access at no cost. You can test transactions, webhooks, and integrations before going live.
Clean, predictable, and fully documented REST APIs for every payment workflow.
Connect **Cursor**, **Claude Desktop**, **VS Code**, and other AI assistants to your Paygent account.
